deadline.value: Graduate applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, with no set deadline.
deadline.quote: For Clarkson University's programs, there are no set deadlines for graduate admissions. Instead, we review applications on a rolling basis.

gre_general.value: The GRE is required, but waivers will be considered.
gre_general.quote: GRE test scores. | Required. Waivers will be considered.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by the Computer Science Graduate Committee; a faculty advisor is chosen only before candidacy.
supervisor.quote: Admission to the computer science program depends upon the Computer Science Graduate Committee's approval.

also.quote: To advance to candidacy, students must have also chosen a faculty advisor

funding.value: The page says PhD applicants are eligible for fully funded assistantships but does not say how many receive one.
funding.quote: PhD applicants are eligible for fully funded research or teaching assistantships.

entry_route.value: A BS or equivalent in computer science or a closely related subject is the stated prerequisite.
entry_route.quote: Prerequisites: A BS or equivalent degree in computer science or another closely related subject.

notes: Admission is by committee; the advisor is chosen before candidacy.
